summary: End-to-end test of the new Pantry Stock (formerly Meals Report) surface. Wrote 9 pytest cases covering items master, purchases, issues, wastage (with reasons) and stock-on-hand math including the opening_stock_as_of exclusion rule — all 9 pass. Frontend Playwright smoke: admin login → sidebar 'Pantry Stock' opens the page, header reads 'Pantry Stock', all 7 tabs render (Daily counts / Monthly / Expense / Purchases / Daily issues / Wastage & losses / Stock on hand), Wastage tab shows reason dropdown + item picker, Stock tab shows Opening / Purchased / Issued / Wasted / On-hand columns, purchases date input capped at today. Zero console errors.

minor.issue: Backend does not reject future dates. Frontend blocks via max attr, but a direct API call with a future date would be accepted. Same applies to /api/meals/issues/{date} and /api/meals/wastage/{date}.

ui_bugs.issue: 'Pantry Stock' appears TWICE in the admin sidebar — once under Coaches (NAV_COACH renders because canMuster=true for admin) and once under Admin (NAV_ADMIN). Not a functional bug but visually confusing.

action_items: Consider deduping 'Pantry Stock' in the sidebar for admins (remove from NAV_COACH, or gate NAV_COACH on !isAdmin).
Optionally add server-side future-date guard to /api/meals/{purchases,issues,wastage}/{date} — currently only enforced by the frontend max attr.
critical_code_review_comments: meals.py has grown past ~1780 lines and mixes Chef's View, meal muster, purchases, items, issues, wastage and stock in one router — worth splitting into meals_muster.py + meals_pantry.py.

Stock math loads ALL purchase/issue/wastage docs up to as_of (to_list(2000)) — fine for now, but should get an as_of >= earliest opening_as_of lower bound too, or a date-range index-friendly pipeline once row counts grow.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_Rice_<uuid> (grocery/kg/opening=10 as-of today) and TEST_Onion_<uuid> (vegetables/kg/opening=3) during pytest run. Items auto-soft-deleted at teardown; associated purchase/issue/wastage rows for today remain in DB (small, marked with TEST_ item names).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reusable pytest file: /app/backend/tests/test_pantry_stock_iter39.py covers full Pantry Stock backend flow. Admin sidebar has duplicate 'Pantry Stock' entry (Coaches + Admin sections) — cosmetic. Stock math (opening + purchased − issued − wasted, with opening_stock_as_of gating) verified correct on the server.
rca of the issue: No issues found. The Wastage tab + Wasted column integrate correctly with the stock formula. Backend correctly excludes purchase/issue/wastage entries dated before the item's opening_stock_as_of.
